```
[LEARN]
insight: Discussion participation tasks should be distinguished from implementation tasks - no code written means standard "feature development" reflection doesn't fully apply
context: When reflecting on research/discussion work, focus on decision quality and verification rather than code metrics

[LEARN]
insight: "No tests detected" suggestion is inappropriate for non-implementation tasks
context: AI discussion participation, research tasks, and code reviews don't produce code that needs testing

[LEARN]
insight: Waiting for heartbeat-based task assignment is correct autonomous behavior when no direct task is assigned
context: Agent should not create work out of thin air - wait for proper task assignment from scheduler

[ISSUE]
title: Reflection prompt assumes implementation work
type: improvement
severity: low
context: System prompts requesting "feature development reflection" should detect task type first
```
